questions.q: Whose son was Solomon, whose proverbs these are?
questions.evidence: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel

questions.q: "The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of" what, in Proverbs 1?
questions.evidence: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge

questions.q: "Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don't lean on your own" what?
questions.evidence: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding

questions.q: To which creature does Proverbs send the sluggard to learn?
questions.evidence: Go to the ant, you sluggard

questions.q: According to Proverbs, what turns away wrath?
questions.evidence: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger

questions.q: According to Proverbs, what goes before destruction?
questions.evidence: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall

questions.q: Proverbs says to train up a child in what?
questions.evidence: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it
answerTerms: in the way he should go

questions.q: "Iron sharpens iron," Proverbs says, and a man sharpens whom?
questions.evidence: so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance

questions.q: What does a cheerful heart make, Proverbs says?
questions.evidence: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones

questions.q: If your enemy is hungry, what does Proverbs say to do?
questions.evidence: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat

questions.q: The worthy woman's price is far above what?
questions.evidence: For her price is far above rubies
